name: Hydra: Sequentially-Dependent Draft Heads for Medusa Decoding
publisher: arXiv (Ankner, Parthasarathy, Nrusimha, Rinard, Ragan-Kelley, Brandon)
notes: Hydra heads are sequentially-dependent drop-in replacement for Medusa's independent draft heads. Hydra++ improves throughput by up to 1.31x over Medusa and 2.70x over autoregressive decoding. Key insight: standard Medusa heads speculate tokens independently of preceding tokens in the candidate continuation; Hydra conditions each head on the draft sequence.
